review: I came in with a rough idea and a cropped reference photo. Arjun drew something better than anything I could have imagined, and the shading work is already settling in beautifully.
Six years of hating a tattoo, one session with Rhea, and it's gone — not covered, actually gone. People ask about the new piece constantly. I can't recommend them enough.
Meera's fine line work is unreal. She sat with placement for almost an hour before a single line — and it shows. It moves exactly the way she promised it would.
The koi on my thigh took three sessions and every one of them felt like a collaboration, not just an appointment. Sidharth treats your body like a canvas with an opinion.
Spotless studio, honest advice, zero pressure. They told me to wait on a piece I was excited about and redesign it — three months later I'm glad they did.
Walked in with a completely open brief, walked out with a sleeve plan. Every step was explained, every price was upfront, and the aftercare follow-up actually happened.
